messages:
customer-alex: Hi team — since ~02:10 UTC we've had sporadic 503s calling /v1/keys/0xA3FF/sign. Errors show hsm:key_unavailable and some signing requests never hit audit logs for ~02:00-02:30. This is affecting EU compliance reporting, can you advise urgent next steps?

hana (support): Sorry to hear that — can you confirm whether this is Redwood Private (onprem connector) or Hosted? Also please paste one request-id and a small log snippet if possible.

customer-alex: It's Private (customer-managed HSM connector, onprem HSM behind the connector). Request-id: req_0b9f3c2a. Here's the agent log around the failure (sanitized):

```
2026-03-15T02:11:54Z ERROR redwood-hsm-agent hsm_client.cpp:412 key_lookup failed id=0xA3FF err=CKR_KEY_HANDLE_INVALID session=0x7f9c
2026-03-15T02:12:01Z WARN  redwood-hsm-agent pool.cpp:98 session_pool exhausted waiting=1
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z ERROR api proxy request req_0b9f3c2a sign failed hsm:error=key_unavailable upstream=503
```

liam (eng-infra): Thanks, that log looks like session exhaustion + intermittent key handle failures. Two quick checks: 1) Did you deploy the connector or agent around ~02:05? 2) Can you run `systemctl status redwood-hsm-agent` and `journalctl -u redwood-hsm-agent -n 200` and paste the output? Also check HSM side for session limits — some appliances have low default concurrent-session caps.

customer-alex: We did a config rolling restart of the connector at 02:05 to roll a TLS cert, yes. Output snippet from systemd: 

```
● redwood-hsm-agent.service - Redwood HSM connector
   Loaded: loaded (/etc/systemd/system/redwood-hsm-agent.service; enabled)
   Active: active (running) since Mon 2026-03-15 02:05:12 UTC
Main PID: 4123 (redwood-hsm-agent)
Mar 15 02:12:01 connector redwood-hsm-agent[4123]: WARNING pool.cpp: session max reached, queueing request
Mar 15 02:12:04 connector redwood-hsm-agent[4123]: ERROR hsm_client.cpp: session_acquire timeout
```

customer-alex: Also see CloudHSM-like console logs (on the HSM appliance):
```
2026-03-15T02:12:03Z libhsm: login failed user=redwood_agent err=CKR_USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN
2026-03-15T02:12:05Z libhsm: session open failed err=CKR_SESSION_COUNT
```

devops-bot: deploy-bot: Completed rolling deploy deploy-834 at 2026-03-15T02:05:10Z :rocket: (changeset: connector:tls-cert+agent-config)

anya (security): Missing audit entries are serious. We need to confirm retention/rotation wasn't accidentally changed by the deploy. Please check /var/log/redwood/audit.log* on the connector host and the HSM's audit export. If audit was rotated or moved, preserve current files immediately (cp before further restarts). Also: were any key objects reimported or any KMS/KHSM roles modified in the same window?

customer-alex: No key imports or role changes. Keys were created 2024-07 and untouched. I copied the connector's audit snippet: `audit.log` shows entries before 02:00 and after 02:30 but nothing in the 02:00-02:30 window.

liam (eng-infra): Likely sequence: rolling restart at 02:05 depleted agent sessions while HSM rejected new sessions (CKR_SESSION_COUNT) and some in-flight requests lost key handles. Immediate mitigations: 
- Increase agent session pool (hsm.max_sessions from 50 -> 200) in /etc/redwood/connector.conf and restart agent in a controlled manner.
- Enable on-the-fly fallback to secondary key routing for sign operations (temporary config `sign.fallback=secondary_key_id`).
- Preserve all current audit files and capture a full `journalctl -u redwood-hsm-agent --since '2026-03-15 01:50' > /tmp/agent-journal.txt`.

liam (eng-infra): Also please run a reproducible curl with debug headers so we can correlate on our end: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Request-ID: req_0b9f3c2a" -d @payload.json https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/keys/0xA3FF/sign
```

customer-alex: Running that now with debug, I've attached the output to the support portal (ticket 2026-1809). Repro shows 2/5 requests fail intermittently.

anya (security): I'll need the preserved audit files and HSM appliance logs to run compliance impact analysis. Please export HSM audit (encrypted) and SFTP to our secure bucket (we'll send creds). Do not rotate or delete logs until security ACK.

oncall-sre: Opening internal incident INC-2026-0456, priority P1 due to compliance/audit gap and production errors. Assigning to eng-infra (liam) and security (anya). Timeline: initial triage within 1 hour, mitigation within 4 hours. I'll request elevated access for support to fetch HSM metrics if you authorize.

hana (support): Action items summary: 1) Customer to preserve and upload connector audit + HSM audit exports (do not rotate). 2) Customer to run increased session config and controlled agent restart OR enable sign fallback. 3) Customer to provide `journalctl` output and curl repro traces. 4) Redwood SRE/security to analyze and confirm compliance impact. We'll update INC-2026-0456 and loop in legal if needed.

customer-alex: Acknowledged — starting audit export now and will hold files. I'll try increasing hsm.max_sessions to 200 in our staging connector and report back. Thanks. :white_check_mark:

liam (eng-infra): If staging confirms fix, we'll coordinate a safe rollout pattern (canary + slow bulk restart) and update guidance to avoid session exhaustion during rolling deploys.

anya (security): Thanks — please tag me in ticket 2026-1809 when upload is ready. Do not delete any audit artifacts.

hana (support): We'll keep this thread updated and mark next steps in the ticket. :triage_flag:
